stage: Frozen S1 local / A2 native-goal compatibility qualification

definitions.local: Exact frozen S1, original 10Hz raw latent, 3 completed 50Hz forces /20, original 50Hz .2s release gate; not arm masking or direct joint correction
definitions.native: Exact frozen A2 direct alpha Student, 50Hz, 320 completed forces /5, original native goal slerp and learned exit; not fixed full goal or retrained rule
definitions.standing: Original verified standing latent, live frozen BFM feedback

physical.anchor: unforced wrist world xyz at3.8s; once aligned, identical partner per task

transition.histories: Both frozen skills warmed continuously fromt3 on same actually executed physical history; never reset at handoff. Each original controller frequency/gate unchanged.
transition.qualification: Fixed scheduler only, not learned contact-dependent selection. No additive latents, no qPD interpolation or direct joints.

stop: No policy training, no optimizer, no changing frozen skills/thresholds/endpoints. At first physical unsafe boundary stop; if no complementarity stop before transition. No parameter tuning after results. One seed qualification, not statistical generalization.
